verdicts.reason: Both throw away the product imagery (the kraft boxes and cup are gone apart from a stray orange sliver at the right edge). Both shrink the two rules to stubs pushed to the very top and bottom, leave a large dead gap between 'Order online' and the subhead, and break 'food & drinks' into three lines with an orphaned '&', set so large it competes with the headline. A's 'drinks' and 'online' run almost edge to edge with no side margin; B's slightly smaller type leaves a little more breathing room, which makes it marginally less cramped.
